name: app-case-study-title-text-with-outlined-service-pills
title: White title slide with a large statement, outlined service pills and team names
whatItIs: A white slide with a small caps project label, a large sans statement 'Making the complex simple, so rest can finally happen. Fewer choices. More clarity. No guilt.', five outlined pills for UX disciplines and four team names separated by bars, on the right half.
whatItMeans: Quiet and confident; big words and outlined pills set the tone for the project.
techniques: Place text on the right half leaving the left empty.
List team names with vertical dividers.

vocabulary.definition: A capsule with a border only.
Content placed on one half of the slide.
